capabilities: Render an interactive Eisenhower matrix in a note via a code block
Drag and drop tasks between quadrants and reorder them within lists
Capture tasks in a toggleable inbox for later sorting
Focus on a single quadrant in focus mode
Store tasks as plain Markdown text with wikilinks and tags
extras: Not yet listed in the Obsidian Community Plugins directory; requires manual installation from GitHub Releases until it becomes available there. Built by Siran (siran.app).
intentEvidence: Unlike standard to-do lists, QuadTasks forces you to make decisions about what truly matters
problem: Obsidian's task lists are flat, so tasks are collected without a built-in way to prioritize them by urgency and importance.
summary: Eisenhower-matrix task manager that renders a 2x2 quadrant block in notes for prioritizing tasks by urgency and importance via drag-and-drop.
